## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (97%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds Normal only; invasive probability is under 1% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 97%, Benign 3% | Clear single leader |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 | No input flag [F6] |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous neighbors [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 2, 3, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 6, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below typical here; not elevated · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 1, 4, 6) · context · Above typical; descriptive only [F2] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 region deletion drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007): not shown to reflect the classifier; lymphocytes only 8/20.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated JPEG-degraded image; reliability AUROC is only 0.69 on a small test set.
- Region 2 alone scores 0.65 on the per-region probe; focal disease may be diluted.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 2** — per-region probe 0.65; confirm benign stroma, no infiltrating tumor.
2. **Regions 1, 4, 6** — confirm lymphocytes are true TILs; spot check was 8/20.
3. **Region 11** — pleomorphism and gland formation peak here; check nuclear atypia.
